scripts.build:wrangler-dev: pnpm run --dir apps/worker build && pnpm run --dir apps/web build
scripts.build: turbo run build && pnpm exec tsx scripts/verify-server-bundle.ts && cp -r apps/docs/.vitepress/dist apps/web/dist/client/docs
scripts.e2e:serve: pnpm run build:wrangler-dev && pnpm run e2e:serve:built
scripts.e2e:serve:built: pnpm exec tsx scripts/prepare-e2e-runtime.ts && mkdir -p .wrangler-home/Library/Preferences/.wrangler/logs && HOME="$PWD/.wrangler-home" ./node_modules/.bin/wrangler dev --config apps/worker/wrangler.e2e.toml --local --no-bundle --show-interactive-dev-session=false --persist-to .wrangler/state/e2e --var TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY:1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA --var AUTH_REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION:false --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 3000 --inspector-port 0 --log-level error
scripts.logo: pnpm exec tsx scripts/generate-logos.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/generate-favicon.ts
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && oxlint --type-aware --tsconfig tsconfig.oxlint.json scripts e2e server.ts apps/web/vite*.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright*.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.oxlint.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json && oxfmt --check scripts e2e server.ts apps/web/vite*.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright*.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.oxlint.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.lint:fix: turbo run lint:fix && oxlint --type-aware --tsconfig tsconfig.oxlint.json --fix scripts e2e server.ts apps/web/vite*.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright*.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.oxlint.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json && oxfmt --write scripts e2e server.ts apps/web/vite*.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright*.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.oxlint.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.format: turbo run format && oxfmt --write scripts e2e server.ts apps/web/vite*.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright*.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.oxlint.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.test:coverage: turbo run test:coverage && vitest run --coverage --project scripts
scripts.deploy:cf: pnpm run build && pnpm exec tsx scripts/deploy.ts
scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && pnpm run typecheck:tests
scripts.typecheck:tests: tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ddl-core/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/workspace-core/tsconfig.test.json
